text: Maya is a university student, and she visits her local library twice a week.
Her home is small and noisy, so she finds it difficult to study there.
At the library, she can use a quiet desk and a computer without paying a fee.
When she does not understand a topic, she asks a member of staff for help.
The staff show her how to find reliable information instead of giving her all the answers.
Maya also joins a small reading group because she wants to improve her English.
Although the members have different backgrounds, they enjoy learning together.
For Maya, the library is not only a place for books but also a place for friendship.
